title: Reuse forward history for a constrained variational equilibrium instead of projecting an inverse
statement: On supplied nonempty closed convex C with F=mI+A,Lip(A|C)<=a<m, the VI <F(x*)-p,z-x*>>=0 for every z in C has a unique solution: T(x)=Projection_C(x+(p-F(x))/m) contracts by a/m. Old feasible native readings give sound outer history balls, not the exact unconstrained inverse family. An active constrained solution may have F(x*)!=p.

body: Projection characterization makes VI equivalent to x*=T(x*); nonexpansiveness and the shifted residual give contraction on complete C. With mu=m-a, strong monotonicity plus the VI test against old feasible x_i gives ||x*-[x_i+(p-p_i)/(2mu)]||<=||p-p_i||/(2mu). Projecting this center onto C preserves the radius. Each exact projected action contracts it; the source simplex implementation rounds after projection with R_next<=(a/m)*R+delta_round and charges the initial rounding too. This differs from the unconstrained rounded-probe update. Independent exact counterexample: F(x,y)=(3x-y,x+3y),m3,a1,C={(x,y)>=0:x+y=1},p=(2,1). Its inverse(7/10,1/10) projects to(4/5,1/5), which fails the VI; the true VI point is(5/6,1/6), with F(x*)-p=(1/3,1/3). Thus projection of an inverse is not the projected fixed-point construction. In the acquired four-task control both solvers have identical final estimates/actual errors; the history-aware certificate is tighter for two interior tasks and tied at vertex/edge. The weaker baseline ignores old outputs; an equally informed projected/bundle method can tie. Four initial calls plus four independent five-call tasks cost24 learner calls/72 scalars, with64 cycle,4 task setter and20 baseline calls separate. No hidden cross-task reuse or physical source acquisition is established.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed intake-author reconstruction of Banach bijectivity, the completed-square inverse equivalence and finite Lipschitz extension argument; same-source relative witness; Slater/KKT/conical sparse support with a bounded nonempty historical family; weighted-square outer certificate; exact saturation geometry, adversarial-noise ambiguity and hidden-bump global-contract failure; projected-VI fixed point and strong-monotonicity history ball, including an independent rational two-dose counterexample to projecting an inverse. Eight saved focused endpoint certificates were independently recomputed using Fraction arithmetic from the six recorded native pairs, including outward square roots; this validates conditional saved bounds, not independent measurement or whole-suite execution. Archive/member/manifest identity, recorded costs, actual bit lengths and saved VI baseline equality were inspected. All four original research programs and verifier were statically read, not run. Numerical search optimality, reported replay, physical validity, novelty and architecture advantage are outside acceptance.
